arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Kneedler argued the lower court erred in finding the statute vague.
Mr. Rosenkranz argued the statute shares critical flaws with the clause struck down in Johnson.
Justice Sotomayor noted the difficulty in defining the ordinary crime for risk assessment.
